description: Add a physical dam maintenance ladder and expose it from the dam top and landing.

replacements.old:
<OBJECT RIVER
	(IN LOCAL-GLOBALS)
	(DESC "river")
	(SYNONYM RIVER)
	(ADJECTIVE FRIGID)
	(ACTION RIVER-FUNCTION)
	(FLAGS NDESCBIT)>
replacements.new:
<OBJECT RIVER
	(IN LOCAL-GLOBALS)
	(DESC "river")
	(SYNONYM RIVER)
	(ADJECTIVE FRIGID)
	(ACTION RIVER-FUNCTION)
	(FLAGS NDESCBIT)>

<OBJECT DAM-MAINTENANCE-LADDER
	(IN LOCAL-GLOBALS)
	(SYNONYM LADDER RUNGS)
	(ADJECTIVE MAINTENANCE SERVICE IRON)
	(DESC "maintenance ladder")
	(FLAGS NDESCBIT CLIMBBIT TRYTAKEBIT)
	(ACTION DAM-MAINTENANCE-LADDER-F)>

replacements.old:
<ROOM DAM-BASE	;"was DOCK"
      (IN ROOMS)
      (LDESC
"You are at the base of Flood Control Dam #3, which looms above you
and to the north. The river Frigid is flowing by here. Along the
river are the White Cliffs which seem to form giant walls stretching
from north to south along the shores of the river as it winds its
way downstream.")
      (DESC "Dam Base")
      (NORTH TO DAM-ROOM)
      (UP TO DAM-ROOM)
      (FLAGS RLANDBIT ONBIT SACREDBIT)
      (GLOBAL GLOBAL-WATER RIVER)>
replacements.new:
<ROOM DAM-BASE	;"was DOCK"
      (IN ROOMS)
      (DESC "Dam Base")
      (NORTH TO DAM-ROOM)
      (UP TO DAM-ROOM)
      (ACTION DAM-BASE-FCN)
      (FLAGS RLANDBIT ONBIT SACREDBIT)
      (GLOBAL GLOBAL-WATER RIVER DAM-MAINTENANCE-LADDER)>
